theme_strategy: Dark mode strictly, modeled after enterprise SIEM platforms (Splunk ES, Elastic Security). No fluff, no gradients.

monospace_data.usage: Hashes, IPs, IOCs, node IDs, T-codes, Sigma snippets

layouts.wireframe_structure: Enterprise Density Grid. Single pane of glass. Top Sticky Header containing Verdict Card -> Top Action Bar -> 2-Column Bento Grid -> Full-width Data Tables.

sticky_regions.verdict_header: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800 p-4 flex justify-between items-center

execution_graph.description: Interactive node/edge visualization of RC5 ExecGraph.
execution_graph.visuals: Technical grid background (CSS repeating-linear-gradient). Nodes are square, flat, 1px border. font-mono for Node ID.
execution_graph.interactions: Hover node -> highlight edges, display tooltip with node payload.

behavior_timeline.description: Horizontal timeline of extracted behaviors grouped by tactic.
behavior_timeline.visuals: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 py-4. Timeline track is a solid 2px line (bg-slate-800). Behavior items are small cards (bg-slate-900 border-l-2 border-l-amber-500) sitting on the track.

mitre_evidence_drilldown.description: Tabular list of MITRE techniques with expandable evidence.
mitre_evidence_drilldown.visuals: shadcn Table. Dense styling (py-2 instead of py-4). Row hover bg-slate-800/50. Font-mono for T-code.
mitre_evidence_drilldown.interactions: Click row -> expands to show behavior evidence strings and Sigma snippets in a sub-table with bg-slate-950.

attack_navigator_btn.visuals: shadcn Button, variant outline, size sm. Icon: Map or Compass (lucide-react). 'Open in ATT&CK Navigator'.
attack_navigator_btn.placement: Top right of MITRE Evidence Table header.

v1_v2_diff_view.description: Analyst diff view of previous vs new verdict/features.
v1_v2_diff_view.visuals: Split pane or diff block. Removed items: bg-red-950/30 text-red-400 line-through. Added items: bg-green-950/30 text-green-400.

verdict_card.description: Top-left sticky card showing verdict, risk score, dimensions.
verdict_card.visuals: Highest priority visual. Huge number for risk score (font-mono text-4xl). Verdict badge uses solid color scale. 7-dimension bars use tiny progress tracks (h-1).

visual_enhancers.style: The 'Technical' Look (Grid Borders). Strict, rigid, flat.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. No large diffuse shadows. Use 1px borders to separate surfaces.
visual_enhancers.borders: border-slate-800 everywhere. Nested containers use border-slate-700.
visual_enhancers.gradients: BANNED. Use flat background colors only.

motion.philosophy: Micro-animations only for functional feedback. No decorative motion.
motion.interactions: hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors duration-150. Node expansion uses linear scale transform.
motion.stagger: Do not stagger table rows. High density data should render instantly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-slate-400 against bg-slate-900 meets 4.5:1 ratio. Adjust if needed.
accessibility.keyboard: All expandable table rows and graph nodes must be focusable (tabIndex=0) and triggerable via Enter.
accessibility.test_ids: Every interactive element MUST have data-testid (e.g., 'verdict-badge', 'node-142', 'mitre-row-T1059').

3d_libraries.recommendation: None. 3D is BANNED for this strict SIEM compliance dashboard. Use 2D React Flow or custom SVG for execution graph.
3d_libraries.alternative: If node visualization is too complex for SVG, use vis-network or react-flow-renderer in strict 2D mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a strict dark-mode dashboard tailored for SOC analysts.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and shadcn/ui for complex interactive components.
Replace all default generic sans-serif fonts with JetBrains Mono or Fira Code for IPs, hashes, T-codes, and IOCs.
Do NOT use any gradients anywhere.
Implement the Execution Graph using React Flow or basic SVG components mapped over the graph data.
Implement the MITRE Evidence Drill-down using a customized shadcn Table with expandable rows (Collapsible).
Keep spacing tight (p-2, p-4) to maximize data density on the screen.
Make the Verdict Card sticky at the top of the viewport.
Bind the 5-Stage Confidence Breakdown to a series of compact Progress components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds under text that overlays images or grids.
Never center-align the main App container. Reading flow must remain natural left-to-right.
Hover states must be distinctly lighter than the active state background.
Add transition-colors for all buttons and interactive rows, but exclude transition-all.
Do not invent new components if shadcn/ui equivalents exist; adapt the primitives.
